program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((div (find-first (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g))))
                         (range 0 (cols g)))))
    (if (eq? div #f)
        g
        (for*/fold ([out g])
                   ([r (in-range (rows g))]
                    [c (in-range (cols g))]
                    #:when (let ((v (at g r c))) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 5)) (not (= c div)))))
          (let ((mc (- (* 2 div) c)))
            (if (and (in-bounds? r mc (rows out) (cols out)) (= (at out r mc) 0))
                (set-cell out r mc (at g r c))
                out))))))
